fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc in computer science at Manchester? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 stages.

Manchester's computer science master's is the MSc Advanced Computer Science. It is a 12-month, full-time programme in Manchester, starting in September 2027. Manchester says it is home to the first university department of Computer Science.

**The most important fact for you:** this is a selective course. Indian applicants typically need about **65%** in a BTech, BE or BSc Eng, depending on the institution.

There are no compulsory units except your Master's Project. You choose four from ten themes, each made of two related course units. The project lets you apply advanced computing techniques to real-world problems.

For the wider university, see our [University of Manchester page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-manchester).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** Successful applicants typically hold a First-class honours degree (**70%** average) or the overseas equivalent in Computer Science, with at least **50%** computer science content. A First is the top UK honours grade. You also need strong programming and software development skills.

**Indian marks.** For India, the course page names a minimum of **65%**, or the equivalent of a First Class with Distinction, depending on the institution, in a BSc Eng, BEng or BTech degree. This is what a typical successful offer-holder shows. It is not a guarantee. Email pgt.compsci@manchester.ac.uk for other cases.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 7.0** overall with no part below **6.5**. TOEFL iBT needs at least **100** overall with no part below **22**. Manchester does not accept TOEFL MyBestScore or the Home Edition.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Manchester's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£41,400** per year (per annum) for 2027 entry. The course lasts 12 months.

Manchester is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027 entry | £41,400 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£53,661** |

The sum is £41,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £53,661. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** Self-funded international applicants pay a **£2,500** deposit towards tuition before a CAS is issued. Some applicants pay a higher deposit. It is refunded only if immigration permission is refused. There is no application fee. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Manchester's Global Futures Scholarship for India is worth **£12,000**. It is a discount on published overseas tuition fees. You must be domiciled in India, which means you mostly lived there in the last three years. You must be self-funded and hold an offer for a full-time, on-campus master's starting September 2027.

- **Deadline:** submit the online form by **25 April 2027**. Manchester emails the form only after you receive an offer.
- **Results:** half the awards are offered by **15 March 2027** and the rest by **1 June 2027**.
- **How it is judged:** on academic excellence and the quality of your form.

See the [scholarship page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/country-specific-information/india/scholarships/). The award is competitive, so the main total above does not count it. If you win, the first-year total falls to **£41,661**.

Graduates of Manchester and Manchester Metropolitan University can also get a 10% tuition discount.

## Deadlines and intakes

Manchester takes applications in four stages for September 2027.

| Stage | Application received by | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 6 November 2026 | 8 January 2027 |
| 2 | 1 January 2027 | 5 March 2027 |
| 3 | 26 February 2027 | 30 April 2027 |
| 4 | 21 May 2027 | 18 June 2027 |

Applications after **21 May 2027** are considered depending on availability. Manchester may roll your application to the next stage, and places are limited, so apply early. Deferred entry is not accepted. A January start is not shown.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** Aim for the typical level: about 65% in a BTech, BE or BSc Eng with strong programming.
2. **Apply online in a stage.** Start from the [course page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/21573/msc-advanced-computer-science/). Apply to one Advanced Computer Science programme only. There is no application fee.
3. **Send your documents.** Include your transcript and an official document showing your weighted average mark. Give the mark as a percentage, not a GPA, if your grades are percentages.
4. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay the **£2,500** deposit to get your CAS. Submit the scholarship form by **25 April 2027**.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Jobs.** Manchester says it runs career fairs, guest lectures and projects with industry partners.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a strong computer science BTech or BE at around 65% or more
- you want to choose your own themes
- you can apply in an early stage

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is not mainly computer science, because the course expects a strong programming background
- you hope to defer your start, because deferred entry is not accepted
- you need a January start, because none is shown

## Sources

- [MSc Advanced Computer Science, University of Manchester](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/21573/msc-advanced-computer-science/). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Global Futures Scholarships for India](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/country-specific-information/india/scholarships/). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [UK student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [money you must show](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money) and [visa fee](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/apply). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Immigration Rules, Appendix Student](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Immigration Health Surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Academic Technology Approval Scheme](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa) and [Graduate visa costs](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa/how-much-it-costs). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [TB test for visas](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk). Checked on 4 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the Manchester MSc Advanced Computer Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £41,400 per year for 2027 entry. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £53,661, or £41,661 if you win the £12,000 India award.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need for Manchester Advanced Computer Science?
faq_json.a: The course page names a minimum of 65%, or the equivalent of a First Class with Distinction, depending on the institution, in a BSc Eng, BEng or BTech.

faq_json.q: Does Manchester need GRE for MSc Advanced Computer Science?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 7.0 overall with no part below 6.5.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Manchester MSc Advanced Computer Science 2027?
faq_json.a: There are four stages. Stage 4 closes on 21 May 2027, and later applications depend on availability.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Manchester?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Global Futures Scholarship gives £12,000 off tuition to self-funded applicants domiciled in India. The form is due by 25 April 2027, after you have an offer.
